exposure: Type of pregnancy cohort (all pregnancies, pregnancies with gestational age >= 24 weeks, low-risk pregnancies with gestational age >= 24 weeks)
outcome: Other pregnancy-related events of interest (15 total)
cohort: Pregnant women in England represented in the Clinical Practice Research Datalink (CPRD) Pregnancy Register linked to Hospital Episode Statistics (HES) between 2005 and 2017, categorized into all pregnancies (N = 298 155), all pregnancies with a gestational age >= 24 weeks (N = 208 328), and low-risk pregnancies with a GA >= 24 weeks (N = 137 932).
finding: The study reported incidence proportions, finding miscarriage most common in all pregnancies and preterm delivery most common in pregnancies with gestational age >= 24 weeks, with results largely consistent with external estimates.
gest_age: Gestational age was used to define cohorts (>= 24 weeks) and as an outcome (preterm delivery < 37 weeks).
